newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt sentences two Moslem militants to death.
newsitem.headline: Egypt sentences two Moslem militants to death.

text.p: Egypt's Supreme State Security Court on Monday sentenced to death two Moslem militants for killing a police major-general and his two assistants in southern Egypt three years ago.

The men, Anwar Hamed Abbas and Ahmed Abdel Wahab Ahmed Khalil, were among 15 charged with belonging to the country's largest militant group, the Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which is fighting to overthrow the government.
